title: Separate additive template writes from explicit destination inventory
failure_signature: A post-copy display coerced five destination values into one invalid path and caused the combined command to exit nonzero.
trigger_preconditions: Writes and display in one command envelope
candidate_workaround: Validate additive destinations in a separate command using explicit wildcard and exact path arguments.
recurrence_guard: Keep mutation and validation receipts separate and enumerate path collections explicitly.
rollback: Do not delete the additive files; inspect them independently and patch only after their exact presence is confirmed.
protected_gates: No validation credit from failed wrapper
scope_boundary: This method validates additive file-inventory control flow only and does not establish content correctness.
